north_star_metric.name: Net Marketplace GMV
north_star_metric.formula: SUM(item_price + freight_value) for order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
north_star_metric.justification: Primary indicator of platform commercial throughput and scale.

repeat_purchase_rate.name: Customer Repeat Purchase Rate
repeat_purchase_rate.formula: (Unique Customers with >=2 Orders / Total Unique Customers) * 100
repeat_purchase_rate.justification: Gauges long-term retention and organic loyalty vs high single-order churn.

on_time_delivery_rate.name: On-Time Delivery Rate
on_time_delivery_rate.justification: Core logistics SLA reflecting fulfillment against customer commitment date.

severe_delay_rate.name: Severe Delay Rate (>7 Days Late)
severe_delay_rate.justification: Operational guardrail metric tracking the primary driver of 1-star reviews.
